# Delegation Bench — ResonantOS add-on

> Which of your real jobs can you safely hand to a local model — and walk away? This ResonantOS 2.0.0-alpha add-on wraps delegation-bench (MIT), the pre-registered delegation benchmark: 9 job classes, certified confidence floors printed on every result, a blinded dual-judge protocol, hidden-test oracles, a sabotage safety cell, and a walk-away autonomy tier. The benchmark runs against YOUR local model endpoint and writes plain files you own. The engine is vendored byte-identical under `vendor/` (hash-pinned by tests); the wrapper is Python 3.10+ standard library only.

## Canonical links

- This repo (the ResonantOS add-on wrapper): https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/resonant-delegation-bench
- Delegation Bench (canonical upstream, the benchmark engine): https://github.com/KyaniteLabs/delegation-bench

## Key facts

- License: MIT (wrapper and upstream engine).
- ResonantOS add-on validator: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- Wrapper: Python 3.10+ standard library only; local service on 127.0.0.1:4890.
- Certified floors: 15/15 = at least 82%; 30/30 = at least 90%. Verdicts per the pre-registered table: RED / YELLOW / ESCALATE / CAPABILITY-GREEN / AUTONOMY-GREEN.
- Loopback only unless you opt in with `DELEGATIONBENCH_ALLOW_REMOTE=1`.
- Results land under `var/<run_id>/` (`decision.json`, `rows.json`, `card.md`), home paths replaced by `~`.

## Relationship

Community gift by Kyanite Labs for ResonantOS — canonical upstream: https://github.com/KyaniteLabs/delegation-bench; this wrapper is non-canonical. If wrapper and upstream disagree, the canonical upstream wins.
